title: Alara Reborn Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Knight of New Alara
entities.description: A knight who embraces all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant, and is called traitor by his former home.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane once divided into five shards, which a knight claims to embrace in full.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: One of the shards of Alara.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: One of the shards of Alara, the former home of the speaking knight.

entities.name: Retaliator Griffin
entities.description: A griffin that answers every wrong in kind, as griffins are fair.

events.summary: The Knight of New Alara declares that he embraces all of Alara and acts because it is right, not for accolades, even if his former home calls him traitor.
events.quote: I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant.
